items.name: agency-services
items.description: A studio or agency site: a big statement on a contour field, services, selected work in a carousel, the way you work, clients and a contact form with a budget choice.

items.name: architecture-studio
items.description: An architecture practice: grid-paper opening, a statement that reveals as you read, project plates, process, history and people.

items.name: careers
items.description: A careers page: why work here, open roles with a team filter and live search, benefits, how hiring works and an open application.

items.name: changelog
items.description: A changelog with the latest release first: dates, headlines, summaries and changes tagged new, improved or fixed with a filter, a reading bar and a subscribe box.

items.name: event-conference
items.description: A bold event site on a warp field: date and place, speakers, a programme per day, tickets with one sold out, sponsors and the questions people ask.

items.name: law-firm
items.description: A law firm on one page: serif opening, practice areas, numbers, partners, a client quote, plain answers and intake.

items.name: newsletter
items.description: A creator's home for a newsletter: a halftone hero with a sign-up that confirms, who reads it, the latest issues, reader quotes, the author and a closing sign-up.

items.name: online-course
items.description: A course sales page with a sketched hero, the curriculum as modules with lesson times and free previews, the teacher, reviews, one price and a reading progress bar.

items.name: podcast
items.description: A podcast site: the show and listen links, a player with a scrubber, episodes that load into it, quotes and show notes.

items.name: pricing-page
items.description: A full pricing page: plans with a monthly and yearly toggle, customers, a comparison table grouped by theme, an enterprise band and billing questions.

items.name: restaurant
items.description: A warm, grainy home for a restaurant: the story in one line, the menu in tabs, a real reservation form with date, time and guests, and hours and address.

items.name: studio-portfolio
items.description: Big typography, a living line study and an intentionally quiet project gallery. A complete home for an independent practice.

items.name: accessibility-preferences
items.description: The settings people reach for first: text size with a live sample, motion, contrast, underlined links and keyboard hints, each applied at once.

items.name: appearance-settings
items.description: Choose how the interface looks: three theme preview cards, a density choice with a live sample list, and an optional font choice, all applied at once.

items.name: authenticator-setup
items.description: Two-step sign-in setup in one card: scan the QR code or type the key, then confirm with the first six-digit code. It works without a camera.

items.name: billing-details-section
items.description: What appears on invoices: company, address, a tax number checked for format and live, billing emails as chips and a reference, saved as one block.

items.name: branding-settings
items.description: How a workspace looks to its customers: logos for light and dark, an icon and a brand colour with a contrast check, and live page and email previews.

items.name: connected-accounts
items.description: The sign-in providers linked to an account: who is connected, as whom and since when, with connect and disconnect per row and a guard on the last way in.

items.name: data-export-section
items.description: The right of access without a support ticket: pick what to include and a format, request the export, and follow earlier ones by status and expiry.

items.name: early-access-features
items.description: Let people opt into previews: each feature with an Alpha or Beta badge, a switch, what changes and how to undo it, and links to give feedback.

items.name: email-addresses-section
items.description: The email addresses on an account: which one is primary, which are verified, add another, make one primary or remove it, each step explained in the row.

items.name: email-preference-center
items.description: The page behind 'manage your emails': a frequency per list, a pause for 30 days, and unsubscribe from everything behind one inline confirmation.

items.name: language-region-section
items.description: Language, country, time zone and formats in one card, with a live sample line showing the date, time and number exactly as they will read.

items.name: privacy-settings-section
items.description: Who can see your profile and what you share: visibility as choice cards, then switches for activity, search and analytics, each saying what it changes for others.

items.name: public-profile-section
items.description: Edit how others see you: picture, display name, @username with a live availability hint, bio with a counter, links, and a preview that updates as you type.

items.name: recovery-codes-section
items.description: Recovery codes shown once with copy, download and print, and a checkbox people must tick to confirm they saved them before they can continue.

items.name: transfer-ownership-card
items.description: Hand a workspace to another member: pick the new owner, read what changes, and confirm by typing the workspace name in a dialog that names what you are giving away.

items.name: workspace-profile-section
items.description: A workspace's name, URL, default time zone and language, with a live preview of the address, a warning before links change and a save that lights up.

items.name: dashboard-shell
items.description: A dashboard frame with named areas: a header with filters, a KPI strip, a main area, a side column and a full-width table zone.

items.name: feed-shell
items.description: Three columns for community and social apps: navigation on the left, a narrow centre feed with a sticky header, and widgets on the right.

items.name: filter-rail-shell
items.description: A layout for any list narrowed by filters: a rail of filter groups, a results toolbar, removable chips, an announced count and a sheet on phones.

items.name: focus-shell
items.description: A distraction-free frame for one task: a minimal header, a single centred column, a quiet footer and a clear way out.

items.name: inset-sidebar-shell
items.description: An app frame with the sidebar on the page background and the page as a bordered, rounded surface beside it, scrolling on its own under a breadcrumb header.

items.name: inspector-shell
items.description: A list or table with a detail panel that opens beside it when a row is picked, with previous and next, and turns into a sheet on phones.

items.name: map-panel-shell
items.description: A full-bleed map or any view with a floating search and results panel that becomes a bottom sheet with three snap heights on phones.

items.name: mobile-tab-shell
items.description: A phone-first app frame: a top bar with title and back, scrolling content and a bottom tab bar that respects the home indicator.

items.name: rail-panel-shell
items.description: A two-level app frame: a slim icon rail for the areas, a panel with the pages of the one you are in, and the content beside them. The panel folds, or opens as a sheet on phones.

items.name: record-page-shell
items.description: The frame for one record, an order, a contact or a ticket: back link, title with status, actions, tabs, and a main column beside a details rail.

items.name: section-sidebar-shell
items.description: Two-tier navigation: the sections of a product along the top, and a sidebar that lists the pages of the current section only. Sheet and scrolling tabs on phones.

items.name: settings-shell
items.description: A settings layout: grouped side navigation, a page title and a focused content column, with the nav becoming a scrolling tab row on phones.

items.name: summary-aside-shell
items.description: A two-column flow layout: the steps on the left and a sticky summary card on the right, which becomes a bottom bar with a sheet on phones.

items.name: top-nav-shell
items.description: An app frame with the navigation along the top: brand, links with the current one marked, search, actions and account, then the page in a container.

items.name: wizard-shell
items.description: The frame for a multi-step task: a top bar with save and exit, a step rail, the step content and a sticky footer with Back and Continue.

items.name: workbench-shell
items.description: A tool layout with an explorer, canvas and inspector you can resize by mouse or keyboard, a toolbar, a status bar and sheets on phones.

items.name: account-chooser
items.description: A 'Choose an account' list of the people already known on this device, with 'Use another account' and a remove control per row.

items.name: authorize-app-card
items.description: The OAuth consent screen: which app wants access, as whom, to what, in plain-language scopes, with Allow and Deny as two filled buttons of one size.

items.name: device-code-entry
items.description: The page behind a CLI or TV login: type the short code from the device, check which device it is, then approve or deny.

items.name: invite-accept-card
items.description: A team invite as a card: the workspace, who invited you and as what, a role you can hover for its powers, and one-click join or a short sign-up form.

items.name: magic-link-sign-in
items.description: Passwordless sign-in: one email field, then an in-place check-your-inbox state with a timed resend and a way back to the form.

items.name: passkey-sign-in
items.description: A passkey-first sign-in: one large "Sign in with a passkey" button, autofill on the email field, and a quiet fallback to a password or a link.

items.name: phone-sign-in
items.description: Sign in with a phone number: a country code and number checked on blur, a text with a code, then six boxes with resend and a way to change the number.

items.name: pin-lock-screen
items.description: A locked-session screen with a numeric keypad: avatar, dots that fill as digits land, a shake on a wrong PIN and a way out to sign out.

items.name: reauthenticate-card
items.description: 'Confirm it is you' before a sensitive action, in a card or a dialog: it names what is about to happen, then takes a password or a passkey.

items.name: set-new-password
items.description: The second half of a password reset: a new password with live rules, a confirm field that checks on blur, and a choice to sign out other devices.

items.name: sso-sign-in
items.description: Work-email sign-in for companies with single sign-on: the domain finds the identity provider and the button names exactly where you are going.

items.name: terms-update-gate
items.description: A re-consent gate for changed legal text: what changed in plain lines, the full documents, one unticked box, and a Continue that says why it waits.

items.name: two-column-sign-in
items.description: A full-page sign-in with the form on one side and a quiet brand panel with a customer quote on the other, folding to the form alone on a phone.

items.name: verification-method-picker
items.description: The 'try another way' step of two-step sign-in: authenticator, security key, text message or recovery code, each with a line on what happens.

items.name: verify-email-card
items.description: The check-your-inbox step after sign-up: the address, a shortcut to webmail, a resend that counts down, a typo fix and an optional six-digit code.

items.name: workspace-url-sign-in
items.description: Sign in to a workspace by its address: your domain after the name, recent workspaces that skip the typing, and a way to find a forgotten one.

items.name: age-verification-gate
items.description: A gate for age-restricted shops: what the shop sells, a date of birth or a plain over-18 choice, and a calm way out for those who fail.

items.name: brand-index
items.description: A shop-by-brand page: popular brands as tiles, every brand under its letter with a product count, a search field and an A to Z jump bar.

items.name: category-product-rows
items.description: Several categories on one page, each with its name, a View all link and a short row of product cards, so the whole catalogue reads at a glance.

items.name: checkout-sign-in-choice
items.description: The fork before checkout: sign in, or continue as a guest with just an email, with what an account adds stated plainly.

items.name: customer-account-home
items.description: The landing of 'My account': a greeting, the latest order with its status, and quick links with counts to orders, addresses, returns and help.

items.name: delivery-instructions
items.description: Where the courier should leave it: hand over, door, neighbour or locker, with the safe choice first and only the fields that choice needs.

items.name: order-help-options
items.description: 'Need help with this order?': the actions that fit its status, each saying why it is available or, with the date, why it is not.

items.name: payment-plan-picker
items.description: Pay in full or in parts: plans as choice cards with the amount per payment, the total, and the schedule of the chosen plan beneath.

items.name: pickup-ready-card
items.description: Your order is ready to collect: a large pickup code with copy and a QR slot, the shop, today's hours, what to bring and how long it is held.

items.name: price-transparency
items.description: Show where the money goes: a stacked bar of materials, making, shipping, duties and margin, with the typical retail price beside it.

items.name: product-passport
items.description: A digital product passport: what it is made of, where it was made, certifications, care and repair, and how to recycle it.

items.name: product-safety-info
items.description: The product safety facts regulations ask for: manufacturer and EU contact, model and batch, warnings, compliance marks and documents.

items.name: ranked-product-list
items.description: Best sellers as a numbered list: a big rank figure, thumbnail, price, proof and a movement word, with a week, month or all-time switch.

items.name: reorder-list
items.description: Order again: the products a customer buys regularly, with the last order date, a quantity on every line and a button to add one line or all of them.

items.name: returns-policy-section
items.description: Returns explained for humans: the window, how it works in four steps, what can and cannot be returned, and when the refund arrives.

items.name: reviews-to-write
items.description: Delivered products waiting for a review: a star pick per product that folds into a thank-you, with Write a review and a Skip that can be undone.

items.name: sample-request
items.description: Order free samples before a big purchase: pick up to five swatches, see what is on its way, and add the delivery address in one short form.

items.name: search-results-header
items.description: The top of a shop search results page: the query as the h1, a polite count, a did-you-mean correction, category tabs with counts and related searches.

items.name: shipping-rates-table
items.description: Where you ship and what it costs: regions, methods, prices, delivery times and the free-shipping threshold in one table, with a country picker.

items.name: trade-account-application
items.description: A dealer or trade account request: company and VAT details, business type, expected spend and a reference, then what happens next.

items.name: trade-credit-summary
items.description: A trade customer's credit at a glance: what is available, a meter that warns in words, payment terms, what is overdue and the next due date.

items.name: warranty-registration
items.description: Register a purchase for its warranty: serial number, purchase date and shop, proof of purchase, then the end date of the cover, shown before sending.

items.name: about-story
items.description: The story of a company in long form: a large statement, two columns of text beside a tall picture, and a strip of the facts that anchor it.

items.name: accessibility-statement
items.description: The accessibility statement a site must publish: conformance in the heading, known gaps with workarounds and dates, how you tested and who to tell.

items.name: allergen-matrix
items.description: Every dish against the fourteen EU allergens in a sticky-header table, with chips that hide dishes containing what you cannot eat.

items.name: article-footnotes
items.description: Footnote references and a notes list with working back links, so a long article can cite sources without breaking the flow.

items.name: article-layout
items.description: A reading layout with header, byline and cover that styles the plain prose elements you pass in.

items.name: article-series-outline
items.description: Where you are in a multi-part series: every part in order, with Read, You are here and Soon told in words, as a card or a strip.

items.name: blog-featured
items.description: An editorial front page: one lead story with a large image and a numbered list of the next ones.

items.name: blog-grid
items.description: Recent posts as cards with image, category, date and excerpt; each card is one stretched link.

items.name: blog-index-sidebar
items.description: A blog front page in two columns: your post list beside a sticky sidebar of search, topics with counts, popular posts and a slot for a sign-up.

items.name: blog-list
items.description: Posts as a list instead of a grid: date in the margin, category, title and one line, separated by rules.

items.name: careers-list
items.description: Open roles grouped by team with a filter row of toggle buttons that show the count per team.

items.name: changelog-list
items.description: Releases on a time rail: version and date in a sticky column, tags, title and the story beside them.

items.name: class-timetable
items.description: A weekly timetable for a gym, school or studio: the week at a glance on wide screens, a day at a time on a phone, with spots left and full classes in words.

items.name: code-of-conduct
items.description: A community code of conduct people will read: the promise, expected and unacceptable behaviour in pairs, how to report, and what happens next.

items.name: cookie-declaration
items.description: The full list of cookies and similar storage by category, with provider, purpose, lifetime and type, to sit behind your banner.

items.name: directions-by-mode
items.description: How to arrive by train, bus, car, bike and on foot, with routes that start at the station, a facts line for each and a step-free access panel.

items.name: docs-page-layout
items.description: A three-column documentation page: your sidebar, the article with breadcrumbs and meta, and an on-this-page rail that tracks your place.

items.name: document-library
items.description: Downloadable documents grouped by category: format, size, pages, language and date on every row, real download links and optional search.

items.name: faq-sidebar-categories
items.description: A long FAQ with a sticky category list on the left and every question open on the right, each answer with its own link to share.

items.name: faq-tabs
items.description: Questions sorted by topic: pill tabs for Billing, Account, Security and so on, each with its own accordion of questions.

items.name: founder-letter
items.description: A letter from the person behind the company: dated, addressed to the reader, set for reading and signed with name, role and portrait.

items.name: help-article-list
items.description: A help centre collection: its title and article count, then articles grouped by section with a one-line summary each.

items.name: how-to-guide
items.description: A step-by-step guide: time and difficulty up front, a tick-off checklist of what you need, numbered steps with pictures and tips, and a closing summary.

items.name: imprint-details
items.description: The legal entity facts a site is expected to show: name, address, register and VAT numbers, who represents it, how to reach it.

items.name: incident-postmortem
items.description: A blameless post-incident report: severity in words, impact in tabular figures, a UTC timeline, the root cause in plain words and actions with owners.

items.name: interview-layout
items.description: A Q&A article with questions set apart from answers, a sticky guest card and room for pull quotes between exchanges.

items.name: job-detail
items.description: A job posting that respects the reader: the facts first with icons (team, place, hours, salary), a short intro, what you will do and what you bring as scannable lists, and apply both on top and at the bottom.

items.name: key-dates-list
items.description: Term dates, deadlines and closures as a clear list of dates and ranges, with the next one marked in words.

items.name: key-takeaways
items.description: A summary box for the top of a long article: three to five takeaways, reading time, intended audience and up to three jump links.

items.name: leadership-bios
items.description: Large portraits and full bios for founders, partners or a board: one person per row, with earlier roles and links.

items.name: menu-section
items.description: A restaurant menu on the web, not a PDF: courses as tabs (arrow keys move), dishes with a line of description and the price, dietary marks that are spelled out for screen readers and explained in a legend, and the allergen note at the end.

items.name: not-found-section
items.description: An error page that helps: plain words, the way back and a short list of places to try instead.

items.name: open-source-credits
items.description: The libraries your product ships, with version and licence, searchable and linked to each full licence text in a dialog.

items.name: pay-bands-table
items.description: Published salary bands by role family and level, with a zone switch, a bar for each range and a plain note on how pay is set.

items.name: portfolio-grid
items.description: Selected work for a studio or a freelancer: filter chips by discipline, a grid of covers with title, client and year, and wide projects across two columns.

items.name: post-feed
items.description: Posts as a reading feed: author, date and read time, then title, standfirst and topic chips, with a square thumbnail on the right.

items.name: press-release-list
items.description: Your own announcements by year: headline, date and optional PDF per row, with the company boilerplate and the media contact in sticky cards beside them.

items.name: privacy-at-a-glance
items.description: Your data practices on one screen: what you collect, why, how long you keep it and who gets it, plus how to use each right.

items.name: recipe-layout
items.description: A recipe page that cooks well: times and servings up front, ingredients that rescale, large-numeral steps with timers and a nutrition panel.

items.name: roadmap-columns
items.description: A public roadmap in Now, Next and Later columns: each item with a status in words and a short why, and no dates you cannot keep.

items.name: search-results-list
items.description: The body of a site search page: result count, type filters with counts as links, results with path and marked snippet, and pagination.

items.name: service-area-list
items.description: The places you work, as links to local pages in balanced columns grouped by region, with a radius note and an Other places line.

items.name: sitemap-page
items.description: A human sitemap: every section as a block with its pages as a nested list, so people and crawlers have a second way to find a page.

items.name: subprocessor-list
items.description: The vendors that process customer data for you: purpose, data, location and transfer safeguard, sorted and dated, with a slot for the notify-me form.

items.name: support-sla-table
items.description: What support you get on each plan: priority levels, first response and target resolution times, channels and hours, in a real table.

items.name: team-by-department
items.description: The whole team as a roster: departments as sections with head counts, people as compact rows with portrait, name, role, place and a link.

items.name: team-grid
items.description: Square portraits or initials with name, role, an optional line and links, aligned on one ratio.

items.name: timeline-section
items.description: A story or a public roadmap in dates, with done and planned milestones told apart in shape and text.

items.name: topic-hub
items.description: The top of a topic page: description, a fact strip, a numbered Start here reading path and related topics as chips.

items.name: troubleshooting-guide
items.description: Problems listed by what the user sees, each opening to the likely cause and numbered fix steps with code or a screenshot, grouped by area.

items.name: values-rows
items.description: Company values as hairline rows: the value in large type, its meaning in a sentence, and a concrete We do and We do not pair.

items.name: version-support-table
items.description: Which versions you still support: release date, end of active support, end of life and a status in words, with the next change flagged.

items.name: video-library
items.description: A library of talks, demos and tutorials: 16:9 cards with a duration chip, speaker and date, grouped by playlist, as links or buttons for your own player.

items.name: affiliate-offer
items.description: Recruit partners: the commission in big figures, how it works in three steps and one apply action.

items.name: app-download-qr
items.description: Get the app on your phone: store buttons, a QR code for desktop visitors and a 'text me the link' field.

items.name: audience-discounts
items.description: Startups, students and nonprofits: a card per group with who qualifies, how much off as the biggest figure and how to apply, so nobody has to ask.

items.name: booking-bar
items.description: A horizontal search bar for stays, rentals and rides: dates in one two-month calendar, guests as counters and a button, stacking into a form on a phone.

items.name: call-us-section
items.description: A phone-first contact block for businesses people ring: the number large, whether the line is open now, and a callback alternative.

items.name: closing-cta
items.description: A composed closing call to action with a generous typographic hierarchy.

items.name: cohort-signup
items.description: The next intake of a course or programme: start date, length, price, seats left and an enrol button, with the application deadline.

items.name: contact-cards
items.description: "Who should I talk to?": one card per route (sales, support, press) with what it is for, how fast you answer, and the one link that gets there.

items.name: contact-faq-split
items.description: Answer before they write: the few questions that fill your inbox in an accordion beside a short contact form.

items.name: contact-form-centered
items.description: A narrow, centred contact form with a topic select, a message and a clear promise of when you will answer, for sites that need one simple way in.

items.name: contact-form-routed
items.description: One form, the right team: the topic you pick changes the questions (order number for support, company size for sales) and who answers.

items.name: contact-section
items.description: Every way to reach you beside a short labelled form with progress, error and confirmation.

items.name: coverage-check
items.description: Ask for a postcode and answer yes, not yet or check the address, with a notify-me field for the places you do not serve.

items.name: credit-packs
items.description: One-off credit packs with the price per credit and the saving against the smallest pack worked out from your numbers, and one pack marked best value.

items.name: cta-banner
items.description: A slim call to action between sections, muted or inverted, copy left and actions right.

items.name: cta-checklist
items.description: The closing ask beside a checklist of everything included, on one bordered surface.

items.name: cta-giant-link
items.description: The ask as one enormous line of type that is itself the link, with an email and a short note beneath, for studios and freelancers.

items.name: cta-image-band
items.description: A closing call to action over a full-bleed photo: a dark scrim from the left keeps the text readable on any picture, in both themes, because the text is always light on the scrim, not on the theme.

items.name: cta-photo-split
items.description: A closing ask beside a real photograph: the picture fills one half edge to edge, the copy and action the other.

items.name: download-section
items.description: The download page section for a desktop app: a card per platform with the detail people check (chip, installer type) and the version and size, each a real download link.

items.name: early-access-form
items.description: A beta application that sorts the waitlist by fit: work email, role, team size and one optional sentence, with an invite code behind a link.

items.name: email-course-signup
items.description: A five-day email course: the lesson outline day by day beside a signup field, so the promise is concrete before the email is given.

items.name: enterprise-plan-band
items.description: The 'need more?' band under the plan cards: what large buyers ask for, who it suits, and a direct line to sales.

items.name: faq-columns
items.description: All answers open in two columns beside the heading, for a short FAQ that should not need clicks.

items.name: faq-section
items.description: A considered FAQ section with accessible expanding answers.

items.name: free-audit-form
items.description: Trade a website address for a free review: URL and email, a validated check and a confirmation that says when the report arrives.

items.name: guarantee-panel
items.description: Take the risk out of the decision: a clear promise (30-day refund, free replacement) with the terms in three plain lines.

items.name: join-count-cta
items.description: A closing ask anchored by a big number: how many people already did it, a stack of faces, and the button.

items.name: limited-offer-panel
items.description: A founding-member or launch offer with a real count of what is left, what you get and the rule for when the price changes.

items.name: location-section
items.description: "Where to find us" for a local business: address as a real address element, phone and email as tap-to-call and mail links, directions, and a slot for opening hours or parking, beside a map.

items.name: name-your-price
items.description: Pay what you want: suggested amounts, a custom amount with a minimum and a line on what the money does, for creators selling digital work.

items.name: newsletter-card
items.description: A compact subscribe card for sidebars and article ends: a line of promise, one field, one button and a note on frequency.

items.name: newsletter-lists
items.description: Let people choose what they get: several lists as checkbox cards with frequency, one email field and a button that says how many lists it subscribes to.

items.name: newsletter-preview
items.description: Subscribe with a look inside: the latest issue as a cover card beside the form, so people see exactly what they will receive.

items.name: newsletter-section
items.description: A newsletter sign-up with what you get and how often, one field and an in-place confirmation.

items.name: office-list
items.description: Every office with address, phone, email and hours, with an open-now line worked out in each office's own time zone and the zone said in words.

items.name: paywall-gate
items.description: The subscribe-to-keep-reading moment: a fade over the last lines of an article, the offer, the price and a sign-in link for members.

items.name: price-list
items.description: The price list of a salon, a practice or a craftsman: groups of services with a dotted leader to the price, the duration or unit beside the name, and the small print underneath.

items.name: pricing-rows
items.description: Plans as stacked rows: name and pitch on the left, price in the middle, action on the right, for four tiers or more.

items.name: pricing-section
items.description: A responsive pricing section with monthly and yearly billing and a plan selection callback.

items.name: pill-capsule
items.description: A single satin capsule with softly rounded ends.

items.name: potted-plant
items.description: A leafy houseplant rooted in a hollow terracotta pot.

items.name: prism-tower
items.description: A tall softened graphite pillar for minimal spatial layouts.

items.name: ribbon-knot
items.description: A continuous satin chrome knot, ready for spatial compositions and GLB export.

items.name: ring-torus-duo
items.description: Two interlocked satin rings forming a simple chain link.

items.name: satin-pebble
items.description: A single flattened porcelain pebble with a gently tilted silhouette.

items.name: shopping-cart
items.description: A wire shopping cart with an open basket, push handle and four casters.

items.name: soft-cube
items.description: A softened aluminium block with rounded edges, editable material and GLB export.

items.name: soft-sphere
items.description: A single porcelain sphere with a soft studio finish.

items.name: stacked-rings
items.description: A compact column of five matching satin rings.

items.name: suitcase
items.description: A ribbed hard-shell suitcase with spinner wheels and an extended telescopic handle.

items.name: tennis-ball
items.description: An olive felt tennis ball with a continuous curved ivory seam.

items.name: tooth
items.description: An ivory molar with four rounded cusps and two tapered roots.

items.name: wallet-leather
items.description: A folded leather wallet with saddle stitching and a brass snap closure.

items.name: wine-glass
items.description: A clear hollow wine glass with a slender stem and a softly turned foot.

items.name: top-loading-bar
items.description: A thin bar across the top that races to 80 percent while a page or action is pending, then sweeps to the end and fades. Work shorter than a delay never shows it.

items.name: auto-height
items.description: A container that glides to its new height when its content changes, for form steps, inline errors and swapped panels, without ever clipping a focus ring.

items.name: count-up
items.description: A number that counts up from zero the first time it is mostly on screen, with prefix, suffix, decimals and locale, and the final value in the page from the start.

items.name: crossfade
items.description: Swap content with a soft crossfade and no layout jump: tab panels, loaded states and changing values, with the leaving content made inert.

items.name: fade-in
items.description: A wrapper that fades and lifts its content in once when it enters view, with direction, delay and duration. Visible without JavaScript and under reduced motion.

items.name: fill-bar
items.description: A labelled bar that fills to its value when it scrolls into view, for skills, quotas and survey results, built on Progress so the real value is always in the page.

items.name: stagger-list
items.description: A list whose items enter one after another when it scrolls into view, with a step, a cap on the wait and real list semantics that stay intact.

items.name: drag-scroll
items.description: A horizontal strip you can drag with a mouse, with optional snap and edge arrows, and full keyboard support. Touch keeps its native scroll.

items.name: edge-fade-scroller
items.description: A scroll container that fades its edges only where there is more to scroll, for chip rows, menus and long lists, and never covers text.

items.name: parallax-layer
items.description: A layer that travels at its own pace while the page scrolls past, with optional zoom and turn.

items.name: reading-time-left
items.description: A reading-time readout that counts down as you read an article, from its real word count, ending in a quiet Done. Screen readers hear the total once and are never interrupted.

items.name: render-on-view
items.description: Mounts heavy content such as a map, a chart or an embed only when it nears the viewport, holding its space so nothing shifts.

items.name: reveal
items.description: Brings an element forward as it scrolls into view, tied to the scroll: rise, tilt, scale, blur or slide.

items.name: scroll-aware-header
items.description: A sticky header that hides on the way down and returns on the way up, or condenses, or turns solid, without trapping focus or shifting the page.

items.name: scroll-away
items.description: The exit counterpart to Reveal: hero text and headers fade, lift and soften as they scroll off the top, in pure CSS with no scroll handler.

items.name: scroll-focus-list
items.description: A list where the item at the reading line is at full strength and the rest step back, for steps, features and long lists, always at readable contrast.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.description: A thin reading bar that fills as you scroll the page or a scrolling panel.

items.name: smooth-scroll
items.description: Optional eased, inertial scrolling for the page or one box, on Lenis, that never fights the browser: scrollbar, Page keys and anchors still work.

items.name: snap-pages
items.description: Full-height sections that snap into place as you scroll, with a dot rail and keyboard paging, on native CSS scroll snap.

items.name: stick-to-bottom
items.description: A scroll area for chats and logs that follows new content while you are at the end, and offers a Jump to latest button once you scroll up.

items.name: sticky-section-header
items.description: Section headings that stick under the page header while their section scrolls, with a hairline and solid background only when stuck.

items.name: text-reveal
items.description: A statement that lights up word by word as it scrolls through the screen.

items.name: view-video
items.description: A muted video that plays while it is mostly in view and rests when it is not, with a pause button that is always there and a poster.

items.name: add-to-calendar-button
items.description: Adds an event to the calendar people use, Google, Outlook, Apple or an .ics file, built from one event object with the time zone handled.

items.name: approval-buttons
items.description: Approve and Reject as one decision: a reason when rejecting, who decided and when, and a short window to change your mind.

items.name: bulk-select-menu
items.description: The header checkbox with a menu for choosing what to select: all, none, unread, starred, with the mixed state and the count in words.

items.name: copy-as-menu
items.description: Copy the same thing in the format the next tool wants: a split button whose menu offers Markdown, JSON, cURL or plain text and remembers the last choice.

items.name: copy-field
items.description: A selectable code field with clipboard feedback and an error fallback.

items.name: directions-button
items.description: Get directions in the maps app people use: Apple Maps on iPhone, Google Maps elsewhere, Waze if they prefer, and the address to copy as a fallback.

items.name: follow-button
items.description: Follow, Following and Requested in one button: optimistic, with a follower count, a clear way to unfollow and a rollback message when the request fails.

items.name: keep-awake-toggle
items.description: A switch that keeps the screen on for recipes, scripts and slides with the Wake Lock API, taking it again after a tab switch.

items.name: like-button
items.description: A like button where the count is the point: it answers at once, rolls the number, plays one quiet ring and tells screen readers the exact count.

items.name: listen-button
items.description: Listen to this article with the browser's own speech: play, pause and stop, a choice of speed, and the sentence being read highlighted.

items.name: pay-button
items.description: The checkout button with its whole life: the amount on it, locked until the form is valid, processing, the bank step, paid, and failed with a safe retry.

items.name: reaction-bar
items.description: Emoji reactions under a message or comment: counts, your own pressed, who reacted on hover, and an add button with a palette you walk with arrow keys.

items.name: save-contact-button
items.description: Save a person or business to the address book: it builds a vCard in the browser from one contact object and downloads it, with no server involved.

items.name: social-sign-in-buttons
items.description: Continue-with buttons for sign-in providers: monogram marks instead of brand logos, a last-used tag first in the list, and one busy state.

items.name: translate-toggle
items.description: Translate a review or comment and back to the original with one quiet control that shows loading, translated-from and failed states.

items.name: use-location-button
items.description: A Use my location button that handles every outcome in words: finding you, found with its accuracy, blocked, unavailable and timed out.

items.name: vote-buttons
items.description: Up and down arrows around a score for questions, answers and feature requests: one vote each, changeable, with the score announced.

items.name: watch-button
items.description: A watch button with levels: all activity, mentions only or nothing, as a split button whose words and bell always say what you will be told.

items.name: activity-entry
items.description: One activity as a sentence: who, what, which object and the from-to change, with a time and an icon.

items.name: attendee-list
items.description: Who is coming: attendees with their response, grouped counts and your own RSVP, for meetings and events.

items.name: call-log-row
items.description: A call in a log: caller, direction as a drawn arrow and a word, time and duration, with a voicemail, a note and a call back button.

items.name: chat-header
items.description: The top of a conversation: avatar or group mosaic, name, presence or member count, and call, search and info actions.

items.name: checklist-card
items.description: A titled checklist with a progress count, strike-through on done items and an add row, for launch and packing lists.

items.name: comment-item
items.description: One comment with author, role, time, an edited note and a body that folds, with reply, edit and delete. Nest replies to compose a thread.

items.name: event-chip
items.description: A calendar event small enough for a grid cell: a bar, the time and a title, in timed, all-day and multi-day styles, with a +3 more companion.

items.name: feature-gate
items.description: A locked-feature panel: the real content dimmed and inert behind a clear message and one upgrade action.

items.name: help-launcher
items.description: A floating Help button that opens a short menu of docs, contact options, keyboard shortcuts and system status, with no third-party script.

items.name: inbox-row
items.description: A message list row: sender, subject, snippet, time, unread and starred states, labels and an attachment mark.

items.name: integration-card
items.description: A connected tool on a settings page: status in words, what it syncs, the last sync, and connect or disconnect with a confirmation and a retry.

items.name: member-row
items.description: A team member as a list row: avatar, name and email, a role you can change, a status that includes pending invites, and a menu of actions.

items.name: message-bubble
items.description: A chat bubble for people talking to people: own and other styles, grouped corners, a reply quote and a send state.

items.name: note-card
items.description: A note as a card: title, a clamped preview, last edited time, a pin and a label, ready for a notes grid.

items.name: notification-item
items.description: One notification row: who did what to which thing, when, an unread marker in dot and word, and the actions that apply.

items.name: project-card
items.description: A project at a glance: name, status, a progress line, team avatars and due date, as one clickable card with a menu.

items.name: reply-summary
items.description: A "5 replies, last reply 2 hours ago" link with a small avatar stack that opens the thread, for message and comment lists.

items.name: sla-timer
items.description: Time left on a service target: on track, at risk or breached, with a paused state while waiting on the customer.

items.name: task-card
items.description: A compact card for a board or grid: title, label chips, due date, assignee stack and subtask progress, ready to be dragged.

items.name: task-relations
items.description: Task dependencies in groups: blocked by, blocks and related, each with its status and an add-link action.

items.name: task-row
items.description: A task as a list row: checkbox, title, due date in words, assignee, priority mark and subtask count.

items.name: time-tracker
items.description: A start, pause and stop timer for time tracking that keeps true elapsed time even when the tab sleeps.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.description: Who is writing right now, in words and three pulsing dots, handling one, two or many people and speaking up politely at most once every few seconds.

items.name: week-strip
items.description: Seven days in a row for choosing a day on a phone: weekday and date, today ringed, dots for days with events.

items.name: add-stepper
items.description: An Add button that turns into minus, count and plus in the same footprint once something is in the cart, as in ordering apps.

items.name: add-to-cart-button
items.description: The buy button with its commerce states: select an option, adding, added with View cart, failed with retry, sold out and pre-order.

items.name: bank-transfer-details
items.description: How to pay by bank transfer: beneficiary, IBAN, BIC, the exact amount and the reference, each with a copy button, and the deadline.

items.name: base-price
items.description: The required price per 100 g or per litre, worked out from the pack size and price, converted, rounded half up and formatted for the locale.

items.name: bill-splitter
items.description: Split the bill at the table: equally or by item, with a tip and an optional round-up, in whole cents so the shares always add up to the bill.

items.name: care-instructions
items.description: Garment care as a row of drawn symbols, each with its meaning in words: wash, bleach, tumble dry, dry, iron and professional care.

items.name: cart-issues
items.description: The problems in a cart that need fixing before checkout: unavailable lines, price changes and minimums, each with its one fix.

items.name: compatibility-check
items.description: Answer "will it fit?" for cases, filters and spare parts: pick a brand and a model and get compatible, not compatible with alternatives, or unknown, never a guess.

items.name: courier-card
items.description: The delivery driver at a glance: photo or initial, first name, vehicle and plate, rating and arrival time, with Call and Message buttons and a same-size waiting state.

items.name: dimension-diagram
items.description: Product dimensions drawn as a simple box, cylinder or flat shape with width, height and depth labelled, switchable between cm and inches.

items.name: fit-scale
items.description: Where an item runs, from small to large, as a five-point scale with the marker placed from review data.

items.name: grade-scale
items.description: A letter-grade scale such as an energy class or eco score: the whole range drawn, steps that differ in length, the product's grade enlarged.

items.name: installment-line
items.description: The "or pay in 3 × 33.00" line under a price, with a popover for the schedule and terms: parts that add up exactly, fees stated, no provider logo.

items.name: kitchen-ticket
items.description: A kitchen order ticket: number, order type, items with modifiers, an elapsed timer that escalates in words, allergies read first and a Bump button.

items.name: mini-product-row
items.description: A one-line product reference for suggestions, bundles and pickers: thumbnail, name, option and price, as a link, a button or a plain row.

items.name: modifier-group
items.description: Options with rules for products and menus: required, pick one or up to N, price add-ons and a polite count of what is chosen.

items.name: order-card
items.description: An order in a customer's history: number, date, status, thumbnails, total and the next step as a button, with the whole card linking to the order.

items.name: order-edit-window
items.description: Tell shoppers a fresh order can still be changed: the time left in words, actions to edit the address or items or cancel, and a calm swap when time is up.

items.name: order-line
items.description: A read-only order line: picture, name, option, quantity times unit price, line total and a per-line status, read out as one sentence.

items.name: order-lookup
items.description: Where is my order? An order number and email form for guests, with answers that never reveal who has orders.

items.name: order-matrix
items.description: Order a product by size and colour in one grid: a quantity field per cell, stock hints, row and column totals, and paste from a spreadsheet.

items.name: price-range
items.description: A price for products with variants: 'From 19', '19 to 39' or one price, with sale ranges handled and struck through.

items.name: product-card
items.description: A production product card for React and Next.js: image with hover zoom, sale and stock badges, compare-at price, colour swatches with radiogroup semantics, add to cart, and a matching skeleton.

items.name: product-info-tabs
items.description: Description, details, shipping and reviews as tabs on desktop and an accordion on a phone, from the same content.

items.name: product-row-card
items.description: A list-view product card for search results: picture, title, rating and facts, then the price block, stock in words and the actions.

items.name: product-tile
items.description: A quiet product tile for editorial grids: one link, a picture that swaps on hover, the name and the price, with a skeleton and no buttons.

items.name: promo-tile
items.description: A promotional tile for a product grid: a picture, a short headline and one action, one or two columns wide, with words on a solid plate.

items.name: quantity-calculator
items.description: Tell shoppers how many packs a job needs: enter an area or a length and width and a waste margin, and get whole packs rounded up, what they cover and the price.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.description: A quantity control for carts: minus, plus and a typed value, with pack steps, a stock cap, hold to repeat and remove at one.

items.name: rating-inline
items.description: Stars drawn to the exact average, the score and the review count in one line, linking to the reviews, for product titles and cards.

items.name: refund-tracker
items.description: Where a refund is: requested, received, approved and paid out, with dates, the amount and the expected arrival once it is approved.

items.name: rental-rates
items.description: Rental pricing by period: day, weekend, week and month rates, the cheapest mix for the dates picked, and the refundable deposit apart.

items.name: return-window
items.description: Show how long an order can still be returned: the closing date, the days left, and open, closing soon and closed states, with Start return only while it is open.

items.name: round-up-toggle
items.description: Offer to round the order up to the next euro for a good cause: the exact extra amount and the cause are in the question, and the switch starts off.

items.name: sales-unit-picker
items.description: Let shoppers buy by the piece, the box, the pallet or by weight: every unit shows its price per piece, switching converts the quantity, and the total is worked out.

items.name: seller-card
items.description: Who sells this: name, verification in words, rating, items sold, reply time and member since, with Contact and Visit store as separate actions.

items.name: shelf-label
items.description: A retail shelf label: name, big price with raised cents, unit price and a scannable barcode, in black on white and printable at true size.

items.name: shipment-group
items.description: Items grouped by shipment: where it ships from, the delivery method and window, a status, then the lines that travel in that parcel.

items.name: shipping-estimator
items.description: Country and postcode in, delivery options out: the cart's shipping estimator with prices, arrival windows and a postcode check per country.

items.name: shoppable-list
items.description: A recipe or project as a shopping list: amounts that scale with servings, substitutes for sold-out lines, and one button that adds the checked products to the cart.

items.name: view-cart-bar
items.description: A bar pinned to the bottom with item count, total and a View cart button, rising when the first item is added and resting above the footer.

items.name: action-tiles
items.description: The things people do most as a grid of tiles: icon, label, shortcut hint, real links or buttons, and a disabled reason in a tooltip that keeps focus.

items.name: attention-list
items.description: What needs a person right now: severity in a shape and a word, the time and one action per row, a dismissal you can undo, or a calm all-clear.

items.name: balance-card
items.description: An account balance for fintech and marketplaces: the available and pending split, next payout, actions, a hide toggle and an overdrawn state in words.

items.name: greeting-header
items.description: A dashboard welcome: a greeting that follows the hour in your time zone, today's date, one sentence from your counts with links, and a primary action.

items.name: metric-strip
items.description: A joined strip of three to five metrics: label, a figure that eases to new values, the change in an arrow and a word, and an honest dash when data is missing.

items.name: monitor-list
items.description: Uptime monitors with the state in a shape and a word, host, response time and time in state. Down sorts first, rows pause from a menu, focus stays put.

items.name: next-up-card
items.description: The next thing on your day: title, time range, place, who is in it and a countdown in words, with Join or Directions and a calm all-clear.

items.name: on-call-card
items.description: Who is on call now and next: shift end times in your time zone, a handover flagged in words, an escalation contact and a Page button that asks for a reason.

items.name: queue-summary
items.description: The to-do strip of an admin home: counters for work waiting, each a link to its filtered list, with a 99+ cap, a quiet zero and a text marker for urgent.

items.name: recent-orders-card
items.description: The latest orders as a dashboard widget: number, customer, date, status in an icon and a word, and the total. A real table that stacks on phones.

items.name: target-pace-card
items.description: A goal with a deadline: the current value, a bar with a tick where an even pace would be today, the verdict in words and the daily rate still needed.

items.name: top-movers-list
items.description: The biggest risers and fallers over a period, with value, change in percent and amount and the direction in words; flat items and tiny bases are left out.

items.name: transaction-list
items.description: A statement grouped by day with sticky headings and daily totals. Money in has a plus and the word Received, pending is marked in words, never colour.

items.name: achievement-tile
items.description: A badge you earned or can still earn: icon, name, how to get it, and a locked, in progress or unlocked state that reads in words, with a one-time shine.

items.name: amenity-list
items.description: What a place offers as an icon grid of amenities, sorted under headings, with a 'Show all 24 amenities' toggle for the long tail.

items.name: api-endpoint
items.description: An API route as one row: the method as a label told apart by weight and outline, the path with its parameters quieter, a line on what it does and the auth it needs.

items.name: app-listing-card
items.description: An app in a directory or store: icon, name, developer, rating and size, with an action that goes from Get to a progress, then Open or Update.

items.name: appointment-card
items.description: An upcoming appointment at a glance: a date leaf, the time and its length, who and where, a status badge, and actions to reschedule, cancel or add to a calendar.

items.name: article-card
items.description: A post or article preview as a single link: cover, topic, date, headline, summary, author and reading time, vertical or horizontal.

items.name: availability-calendar
items.description: A read-only calendar of free, booked and on-request days for rentals, venues and rooms, told apart by pattern and a legend in words, never by colour.

items.name: book-card
items.description: A book in a catalogue: a 2:3 cover with a typographic fallback, title, authors, rating, formats and whether it is available, reserved or out on loan.

items.name: booking-summary
items.description: What you are about to book, as a list: service, date and time, who and where, the total set apart, and an edit link on every row.

items.name: certificate-card
items.description: A certificate of completion as a card: recipient, course, dates, a copyable credential ID, and download and verify actions that still read in black and white.

items.name: class-session-card
items.description: A class you can book: date tile, time and length, coach, room and level, spots left with a fill bar, and a Book, Join waitlist or Cancel action.

items.name: color-token-card
items.description: A design colour documented: swatch, name and token, a value that copies as hex, rgb or oklch, and its contrast on white and black with pass marks.

items.name: commit-list
items.description: Commits grouped by day under sticky headings: subject link, author, time in words, CI status as a glyph and word, and a short hash that copies.

items.name: company-card
items.description: A company at a glance for CRMs and directories: logo, name, domain, status, and facts for industry, size, place, owner and last contact.

items.name: coupon-card
items.description: A voucher: the offer, its code with a copy button, the conditions and the expiry, on a card with a perforated edge.

items.name: course-card
items.description: A course in a catalogue: cover, level, instructor, length, rating and price with its discount in words, or progress and Continue once enrolled.

items.name: curriculum-list
items.description: A course outline: modules that fold open to lessons with type, length and state, so learners see what is done, current, locked or free to preview.

items.name: delivery-stop-card
items.description: One stop on a delivery route: sequence marker, recipient and address, time window and parcels, with call, navigate and outcome actions.

items.name: expandable-text
items.description: Long text folded to a few lines, with a Show more toggle that appears only when something is actually hidden and moves the height.

items.name: experience-list
items.description: A CV section: roles with organisation, dates and duration, a few lines on what was done and skills as tags, in a two-column rhythm that stacks on a phone.

items.name: flight-card
items.description: A flight option: departure and arrival in each airport's own time, duration and stops in words, airline, price and a select action, with every segment on demand.

items.name: fundraiser-card
items.description: A fundraiser: the story in a line, the amount raised against the goal as a real progress bar, donors, days left, the organiser and a donate action.

items.name: ingredient-list
items.description: A recipe's ingredients that scale: change the servings and the amounts follow, as kitchen fractions or metric decimals, with lines you can tick off.

items.name: invitation-card
items.description: An invitation you received: who sent it, what to and as which role, with Accept and Decline of equal weight and the outcome in words afterwards.

items.name: job-card
items.description: A job opening as one card: company, title, a labelled list of place, mode, contract and pay, skill tags, how fresh it is, and a save toggle.

items.name: match-score-card
items.description: A fixture or result: two teams, the score, the state (live, full time or kickoff time) and the competition, read as one sentence.

items.name: match-timeline
items.description: The events of a match on a centre line: goals, cards and substitutions with the minute, the player and the side, in one column on a phone.

items.name: membership-card
items.description: A digital membership card: member, tier, member since and valid until, with a QR code that opens large for scanning and a copyable member number.

items.name: payment-card-preview
items.description: A payment card drawn live as you fill in the form: number grouped by network, name and expiry, the brand in words, a back for the code, nothing stored.

items.name: plan-card
items.description: One plan as a card: its price and interval, what it includes and the button, with 'Most popular' and 'Your plan' told in words, not only in colour.

items.name: player-card
items.description: A squad member for a club site: portrait, shirt number, name, position, nationality and season stats, with injured and suspended players marked in words.

items.name: price-quote-card
items.description: A price quote you received: number, validity, total with tax stated and its status, with accept and decline of equal weight, download and a way back when it expires.

items.name: priority-indicator
items.description: Priority as a drawn mark and a word: urgent, high, medium, low or none, readable without colour, and optionally a menu to change it.

items.name: property-card
items.description: A home listing as a card: a gallery of photos with arrows, the price in tabular numerals, the address, bedrooms, bathrooms and area with units, a status and a save toggle.

items.name: recipe-card
items.description: A recipe in a card: photo, title, total time with prep and cook in a tooltip, difficulty, servings, dietary marks as words and a rating.

items.name: relative-time
items.description: A time element that reads '5 minutes ago', keeps itself current without ticking, and shows the exact date, time and zone in a tooltip.

items.name: repo-card
items.description: A code repository as a card: owner and name as one link, description, topics, language, stars, forks and when it last changed.

items.name: room-card
items.description: A hotel room or rental: photos, size and beds, amenities, the price per night and the stay total, with 'Only 2 left' and sold-out states in words.

items.name: season-strip
items.description: Twelve months in a strip that show when something is at its best, with states you read without colour, a legend in words and a note in a tooltip.

items.name: service-card
items.description: A bookable service: name, what is included, and duration and price as a labelled pair, with a select or book action and a from-price state.

items.name: specialist-card
items.description: A person you can book: photo, name, specialties, languages, rating and the next free slot in words, with a book action kept apart from the profile link.

items.name: stack-trace
items.description: An error's stack trace made readable: your own frames in full weight, library frames folded away, copyable file locations and one button for the whole trace.

items.name: stamp-card
items.description: A digital loyalty stamp card: a grid of stamps with the filled ones drawn, the reward on the last one, and a Redeem button once the card is full.

items.name: team-clocks
items.description: The time for each teammate: name, city and local time as a list or an analog face, with Working or Off hours in words and the offset to you.

items.name: testimonial-card
items.description: One customer quote as a card: the words, the person with a portrait or initials, their role and an optional rating written in words.

items.name: tour-card
items.description: A guided tour or activity in a listing: photo, title, duration, group size, languages, rating and the price from, with cancellation stated in words.

items.name: vehicle-card
items.description: A vehicle listing for a dealer: photo gallery, price with an optional monthly figure, key specs as a labelled list, status in words and a save button.

items.name: venue-card
items.description: A local business in a directory: photo, name, category, rating, price level, distance and an open-now status in words, with a save button.

items.name: batch-progress
items.description: Progress for work on many items at once: one bar, a count of done, failed and waiting, and a Cancel that stops the rest.

items.name: bulk-result-summary
items.description: The outcome of a batch job in numbers: what worked, what was skipped and what failed, with each failure's reason and a retry.

items.name: coming-soon-state
items.description: A placeholder for a feature that is not ready: what it will do, roughly when, and a button to be told when it launches.

items.name: draft-restored-notice
items.description: Tells people their unsaved work came back after a crash or a closed tab: when it was saved, Keep or Start over, plus a useLocalDraft hook.

items.name: empty-state
items.description: A considered empty state with a heading, explanation, icon and recovery action.

items.name: first-run-state
items.description: The empty state for a brand new account: one promise and two to four ways to begin, as cards in one keyboard group, with a Recommended one and a quiet Skip.

items.name: mode-bar
items.description: A bar that says you are in a special mode (test data, viewing as someone else, read-only or beta) and gives the one way out. It cannot be dismissed.

items.name: needs-setup-state
items.description: Stands in for a feature that needs one step first: what is missing, why, the steps done and left, and the action that fixes it.

items.name: notice-stack
items.description: Several notices in one place: the most urgent on top, the rest folded under '+2 more', each closable on its own.

items.name: offline-state
items.description: The page-sized 'you are offline' state: what still works on the device, a Try again button, and a Back online moment with an automatic retry.

items.name: payment-failed-banner
items.description: A banner for a failed subscription payment: which card, the date it becomes a problem, and one button to fix it. Turns destructive once access is paused.

items.name: permission-primer
items.description: The soft ask before the browser's permission prompt: why you need notifications, camera, microphone or location, and what to do if blocked.

items.name: pwa-install-prompt
items.description: A prompt to install your web app: a real Install button where the browser supports it, and share-sheet steps on iPhone.

items.name: queue-position
items.description: A waiting-room panel for being in line: your place, an honest wait range, and a Leave button that asks before it lets go of the spot.

items.name: streak-tracker
items.description: A week of days with the streak count: filled for days done, ringed for today, hollow for what was missed.

items.name: suspicious-activity-alert
items.description: A 'was this you?' alert for an unfamiliar sign-in, with device and place, and two clear answers: yes, or secure my account.

items.name: trial-status-bar
items.description: A header strip counting the days left in a trial, with a thin progress line and an Upgrade button that gets firmer in the last days and after the end.

items.name: unavailable-state
items.description: For a link that no longer works (expired, used, revoked or removed): the reason in words, the date it happened and the next step, with a resend cooldown.

items.name: unsupported-browser-notice
items.description: A calm notice for a browser that cannot run your app: what is missing in plain words, which browsers work, and Continue anyway.

items.name: update-available-bar
items.description: A slim bar saying a new version is ready, with Reload now, Later (remembered for the session) and a link to what changed. Announced once, never steals focus.

items.name: verify-email-banner
items.description: A banner for unverified accounts that names the address, resends the email with a cooldown that survives a reload, and lets people fix a typo.

items.name: agreement-scroll
items.description: Terms in a scrolling box with a read-progress line; the accept checkbox unlocks at the end, and keyboard users and short texts still work.

items.name: answer-checklist
items.description: A checklist where each item gets an answer, Pass, Fail or N/A, or Yes and No, with a note that opens on the answers that need explaining.

items.name: answers-review
items.description: Check your answers before sending: grouped answers in a summary list, each with a Change link and a clear Not provided marker.

items.name: card-fieldset
items.description: Card number, expiry and security code as one connected group with spacing, brand detection and a Luhn check, ready to swap for hosted fields.

items.name: comment-composer
items.description: A comment box that stays one line until focused, then offers Cancel and Comment, sends with Cmd or Ctrl Enter and keeps the draft.

items.name: conditional-fields
items.description: A checkbox, switch or radio that reveals its own fields when chosen: the reveal is announced, and hidden fields are inert and left out of the submit.

items.name: contact-fieldset
items.description: Contact details for a checkout or enquiry: first and last name, email and phone with country code, with autofill tokens and per-field errors.

items.name: danger-zone
items.description: The destructive actions of a settings page in one clearly marked section, each with its consequence in words and a confirm step.

items.name: discount-field
items.description: A discount as either an amount or a percentage, with the switch inside the field and the resulting price shown against the original.

items.name: document-upload-row
items.description: One requested document, such as a passport or proof of address, with its status, the chosen file and replace and remove, ready to stack.

items.name: drop-overlay
items.description: Let people drop files anywhere on a page or panel: an overlay appears the moment a file is dragged over it and says what will happen, or why not.

items.name: editable-section
items.description: View or edit a group of details in place: a summary with an Edit button turns into fields with Save and Cancel, and focus returns when done.

items.name: event-time-fieldset
items.description: When does it happen: start and end date and time, an All day switch, and an end that moves with the start so the length is kept.

items.name: facet-filter
items.description: A filter button that opens a searchable checklist with row counts; picks show on the button as chips or a count, with Clear filter at the foot.

items.name: field-repeater
items.description: An 'Add another' group of fields that repeats row by row, with add, remove, a minimum and maximum, and focus that lands in the new row.

items.name: filter-row
items.description: The row of controls above a list: search, your filters and a Reset that counts what is active, folding into one Filters button and a sheet on a phone.

items.name: focal-point-field
items.description: Mark the part of an image that must never be cropped: click or drag a point and see square, wide and tall crops that keep it in view.

items.name: form-actions
items.description: The button row that ends a form: primary last, Cancel beside it, a destructive action kept apart, a pending state, a hint and an optional sticky bar.

items.name: form-dialog
items.description: A dialog that is a form: Enter submits, buttons lock while it saves, closing is blocked mid-save and a failed save keeps everything typed.

items.name: form-outline
items.description: The jump list of a long form: each section with Done, Needs attention or Not started in shape and text, the one in view marked as you scroll.

items.name: form-section
items.description: A fieldset with a legend, help text and a Required or Optional note, stacked or split into a sticky title column and a card of fields.

items.name: form-tabs
items.description: A long form split across tabs that still submits as one: errors show on the tab, and a field inside a hidden panel is revealed before it is focused.

items.name: guest-picker
items.description: Adults, children and infants in one popover: a stepper for each, ages as help text, and limits that explain themselves in words when they stop a button.

items.name: image-alt-field
items.description: Upload an image and describe it in the same place: a preview, an alt text box with live advice, and a decorative checkbox that is a deliberate choice.

items.name: image-cropper
items.description: Choose the crop of a photo: drag it under a fixed frame, zoom with a slider or the keys, lock an aspect ratio and get the rectangle back.

items.name: image-upload-grid
items.description: Manage the images of a product or a gallery: add tiles, mark the first as main, reorder with buttons or drag, and remove.

items.name: inherited-field
items.description: A setting that follows its parent until you override it: the inherited value shown and named, an Override switch, and Reset back to inherited.

items.name: likert-matrix
items.description: Several statements on one scale: a real table with one tab stop per row, a sticky statement column, and one card per statement on a phone.

items.name: product-pricing-fieldset
items.description: Price, compare-at price and cost for a product form, with the discount, profit and margin worked out as you type.

items.name: quiet-hours-field
items.description: Do not disturb on a schedule: a switch, from and to times, the days it applies to, and a sentence that understands overnight ranges.

items.name: radio-accordion
items.description: Payment or delivery methods as radio rows where the chosen one opens its own panel beneath and the others stay shut.

items.name: rating-filter
items.description: '4 stars and up' as a filter: a radio list of star rows with the number of products beside each and an Any rating choice.

items.name: record-lookup
items.description: Pick one record from a big table: a field with a Look up button that opens a searchable, sortable, paged table in a dialog, loaded from your server.

items.name: report-form
items.description: Report a post, a listing or a user: a short list of reasons, a detail box that opens when it helps, and clear words on what happens next.

items.name: segmented-control
items.description: A controlled segmented choice with roving keyboard focus.

items.name: send-schedule-field
items.description: Send now or later: two choices, a day and time that open for later, the time zone in words, and a sentence saying exactly when it goes out.

items.name: seo-fieldset
items.description: Page title and description fields with a live search-result preview and a length meter that turns to words before text would be cut off.

items.name: social-links-fieldset
items.description: Profile links with each network's address pre-filled: paste a full URL and it is cut down to the handle, then checked.

items.name: status-message-field
items.description: Set what you are up to: a short status with an icon, quick presets such as In a meeting, and when it should clear itself.

items.name: status-select
items.description: Pick a status where the shape tells the state, not the colour: a marker and a word per option, grouped into open and closed, in a compact trigger.

items.name: stock-adjust-field
items.description: Adjust stock without doing sums: add, remove or set a quantity, give a reason, and see on hand before and after.

items.name: tiered-rates-editor
items.description: Edit price breaks, shipping bands or commission tiers: ranges that chain automatically, so there are never gaps or overlaps.

items.name: transfer-list
items.description: Move items between Available and Chosen: two searchable listboxes, add and remove buttons, double-click or Enter, counts, and moves that are announced.

items.name: translatable-field
items.description: One field in many languages: a tab per language with a clear missing mark, so editors see what is translated and what is not.

items.name: utm-builder
items.description: Build a tracked link: a base URL plus source, medium and campaign, with the result live, encoded and ready to copy.

items.name: vat-price-field
items.description: Enter a price once and see both sides, with and without VAT, with a switch for which one you type and the VAT worked out between them.

items.name: dashboard-grid
items.description: A 12-column grid for dashboard widgets: sizes by name, rows of one fixed height so tall and short widgets line up, and one column on a phone.

items.name: animated-number
items.description: Smooth interruptible number transitions with locale formatting and a stable accessible value.

items.name: animated-price
items.description: Currency-aware price transitions with the same soft count and blur across every price update.

items.name: category-nav
items.description: A category tree that shows only the current branch: parents above, siblings beside, children below, with counts.

items.name: region-switcher
items.description: Where you ship to and what you pay in: a country and a currency in one small panel, saved with one button.

items.name: address-confirm-dialog
items.description: A checkout dialog for an address that cannot be verified exactly: what was typed beside the suggestion, the differences in bold, to choose from or to edit.

items.name: metric-definition-popover
items.description: Explain a number where it is shown: an info button that opens the metric's definition, formula, source, freshness and owner, so people stop asking what it means.

items.name: price-breakdown-popover
items.description: A price you can press to see how it is made up: base, discounts, shipping and VAT as lines that add up to the total, with the rate named.

items.name: crosstab-table
items.description: One measure by two dimensions with row, column and grand totals, read as a real table and with an optional five-step shading that never hides the number.

items.name: data-preview-table
items.description: A peek at tabular data: row numbers, a type chip on every column, nulls shown as nulls and a clear 'Showing 10 of 12,430 rows'.

items.name: field-diff-table
items.description: What changed on a record: each field's old and new value side by side, with added and removed values marked in words. For audit trails and approvals.

items.name: line-items-table
items.description: Priced lines as a table: description, quantity, unit price and amount, with subtotal, discount, shipping, VAT and total in a real tfoot, counted in whole cents.

items.name: offer-list
items.description: Other offers for the same product: seller and rating, condition, delivery and the price with shipping, sortable, with the best price named and an add button per row.

items.name: price-matrix
items.description: A price grid for made-to-order products: sizes down, materials or quantities across, every price a radio in one group, the chosen row and column quietly marked.

items.name: raci-matrix
items.description: Who does what on a project: tasks down, people across, an R, A, C or I in each cell, and a check that every task has exactly one accountable person.

items.name: virtualized-table
items.description: Thousands of rows rendered as a few dozen: a windowed table with a fixed row height, a sticky header and true row counts for screen readers.
